from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingProfit(BaseModel):
    """Operating profit extracted from one company's financial report for the reporting period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock securities code")
    operating_profit: float | None = Field(description="Operating profit amount; negative values indicate loss")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="The financial statement section where the data appears, e.g., '合并利润表'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_profit_records: list[OperatingProfit]
